lens: Skeptic. Every detail is assumed wrong until a real photo shows it right. In-service photos re-downloaded into ref/web/econ (SANspotter NH7 set 13-30, flight-report 57325 NH5 JA794A) decide geometry; official ANA photos y_47300-07 decide colours and finishes. The renders are the current head (25dd6df, which includes cc096b3), from the /tmp/claude-0/b build of 14:02. Extra studio shots of econ3 are in /tmp/claude-0/raterA6/x (x1_backtop, x2_headfront, x3_aisleend, x4_front_low, x5_backsq). Comparison sheets are in /tmp/claude-0/raterA6: cmp_head.jpg, cmp_h2.jpg, cmp_top.jpg, cmp_q17.jpg, fab.jpg, tex.png, hook.jpg. Notes: the q15 camera sits higher and closer than y_47300, so the armrests are out of frame; q17 does not match the y_47303 viewpoint. Both are harness issues and are not scored against econ.

priorIssues.issue: w5a-1 (high): the petal fleck fabric is missing
priorIssues.evidence: SEATMAT.yFabricD with the y_fleck tile is about 40 % of seats. q15 seat 4 back measures #1e234e, L p10/50/90 31/39/80, p90/p50 2.07. y_47300 fleck seat 4 measures #212e55, 29/46/88, 1.91; seat 2 #26345e, 33/52/100, 1.91. Hue is slightly too purple (G/B 0.45 vs 0.54). The fleck shape is still thin comma strokes rather than round petals (fab.jpg); see w6a-7.

priorIssues.issue: w5a-2 (high): a fabric cap shows over the back top; the real top has only a thin navy rim
priorIssues.evidence: x1_backtop / cmp_top.jpg / cmp_q17.jpg: a fabric band about 0.03-0.045 m deep still shows over every back top, with ragged white streaks along it. Code: the back loft's end cap and the shell RS end cap are both at y = 0.868 (coplanar caps, so they z-fight). The back spans z -0.002..0.042 and the shell z 0.010..0.072. At y 0.838 the back is 0.382 wide against the shell's 0.37, so fabric pokes out at the sides. Real photos (sans 22, fr57325 124234, sans 15) show a rim of about 0.012 m (15-20 px over a 530 px hood).

priorIssues.issue: w5a-3 / w5b-1 (high): the tick and diamond fabrics are far too light
priorIssues.evidence: q15 backs L50 49 / 57 / 70 (diamond) / 39 against y_47300 91 / 52 / 69 / 46. Hue matches (R/B 0.39-0.51, G/B 0.45-0.60 against 0.39-0.53 / 0.54-0.65). The tick seat is now on the dark side (q15 tick 57 against y_47300 tick 69-91), but that is acceptable.

priorIssues.issue: w5a-4 / w5b-2 (medium): the diamond weave has figure and ground inverted, and the pitch is too large
priorIssues.status: not fixed (the pitch is fixed, the coverage is not)
priorIssues.evidence: The same-row pitch is now about 0.087 m. Otsu light-area, blurred: q15 0.46, x2 0.51, x4 0.58, and tex/tex_y_diamond.png itself 0.54. Photos: y_47306 0.24, y_47302 0.21, sans 13 0.16. Cause: make_swatches.py y_diamond quantises distances with np.floor(|u-cu|/step)*step, which shrinks the distance and grows each diamond by up to one 5 mm step per axis (nominal 0.026/0.022 becomes about 0.031/0.027, so about 45 % area), and the edge noise adds more. Diamonds still read as an argyle lattice with thin navy lines (fab.jpg).

priorIssues.issue: w5a-5 (medium): the belts are stubs, the buckle is misplaced and the colour is cerulean
priorIssues.evidence: The webbing now runs from the side creases to a latch at mid-pan (x4, e1, e7), matching y_47303. In-cabin q16 belt #1d3b83 L 58 sits between y_47303 teal (#417bbf / #4366a8) and y_47302 slate (#2f3458). Studio e1 #588ed2 is bright, but that is the studio light. It still looks like a rigid flat tape (low).

priorIssues.issue: w5a-6 / w5b-3 (medium): the headrest cover is too light and grey
priorIssues.evidence: q15 cover #252b4a L 45 against y_47300 #282e49 L 47 (match). q16 cover/back is 42/72 = 0.58, against y_47301 67/82 = 0.82, y_47306 79/62-76 = 1.0-1.1 and sans 13 78/75 = 1.04. It is now a little too dark and blue (R/B 0.50 against 0.59-0.68 in y_47301 / y_47306).

priorIssues.issue: w5a-7 (medium): the screen bezel nearly fills the hood face
priorIssues.evidence: Pixel scan of q18 row 255: hood x 276-656, bezel 296-636, so bezel/hood is 0.89. y_47305 row 430 gives 582/720 = 0.81, and sans 22 gives 455/528 = 0.86. The model has bezel 0.316 on a 0.38 hood (0.83), but the 0.03 corner radius turns the hood edges away, so the flat face reads narrower.

priorIssues.issue: w5a-8 / w5b-9 (low): the pocket net is an opaque slab; the hubs poke past the shell
priorIssues.evidence: e6 and x5: the net is still a solid dark 0.31 x 0.07 band. sans 20 / 23 show a see-through black mesh with a ruched top. The hubs now sit at s*0.198, inside the shell side.

priorIssues.issue: w5a-9 / w5b-4 (medium): the footrest hangers are kinked boxes at the pedal outer ends
priorIssues.evidence: The hangers are now at x0 +/- 0.035 (sans 23, y_47304 OK). But each hanger is 4 separate gRBox blocks stepping in angle, which read as a segmented spine of white vertebrae in e8 and x1. y_47304 and sans 23 show one smooth, broad, bowed off-white arm. The shared joint block is dark #4a4e55, while the y_47304 hinge is silver.

priorIssues.issue: w5a-10 (low): the headrest wing ends are flat and the ANA mark is a grey patch
priorIssues.evidence: The mark is now a thin 14 x 6 mm logotype. The cushion wings are barely readable in q15, x2 and x4 because the cushion and the back share the same fleck fabric and have no seam or shadow line (cmp_h2.jpg). See w6a-6.

priorIssues.issue: w5a-11 / w5b-5 (medium): the pillow is small and rigid
priorIssues.evidence: The pillow is now 0.35 x 0.24 and domed, with colour q15 #313a68 (R/B 0.47, G/B 0.56) against y_47300 #2c3357 / #232946 (0.50 / 0.59). Its edges are still straight with rounded corners (x4). y_47300 and sans 13 pillows have concave edges and pinched corners (bow-tie outline).

priorIssues.issue: w5b-6 (medium): the armrests are too thick with a square nose
priorIssues.evidence: The loft is now 5.5 cm with a drooping nose and a slim bracket (e7, x3), which reads close to the y_47303 / y_47302 slim off-white arms.

priorIssues.issue: w5b-7 (low): the mosaic is blobby camouflage
priorIssues.evidence: fab.jpg: q15 seat 2 shows irregular light-blue blobs. y_47306 right seat shows horizontal white dashes, about 6-12 x 1-1.5 mm, in a checker of dense and sparse rectangular cells. Photo p90/p50 2.18; render 1.84.
q16 #1d3b83. Only the studio shows it bright.

issues.title: Back top: the shell and fabric end caps are coplanar at y 0.868 (z-fighting streaks), and a 3-4.5 cm fabric band plus side bulges show above and beside the hood from behind
issues.evidence: x1_backtop, cmp_top.jpg, q17 foreground: a ragged white/blue strip runs along each top. sans 22, sans 15 and fr57325 124234 show a smooth rim of about 0.012 m. Code (09a_econ.js econSeat): the back loft ends with SEC(0.868, 0.29, 0.044, 0.02) and RS ends with [0.868, 0.072, 0.062, 0.30], so both caps sit at the same y. The back at 0.838 is 0.382 wide against RS at 0.835, 0.37.
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js econSeat. Back loft: replace the last two sections with SEC(0.857, 0.334, 0.052, 0.018, 0.02) and SEC(0.862, 0.29, 0.044, 0.02, 0.016). RS: replace the last three rows with [0.835, 0.114, 0.09, 0.40, 0.03], [0.855, 0.10, 0.11, 0.39, 0.03], [0.874, 0.07, 0.085, 0.31, 0.022]. The top row then spans z -0.015..0.07, covering the back cap (z -0.002..0.042) with about 1 cm of fabric rim showing in front, and its cap sits 12 mm above the back cap. Re-check x1 / q17 for a rim of 0.010-0.015 m and no streaks.

issues.title: Diamond fabric is still pale-dominant (argyle lattice), not sparse stepped diamonds on navy
issues.evidence: Otsu light-area: swatch tex_y_diamond.png 0.54, q15 0.46, x4 0.58. Photos: y_47306 0.24, y_47302 0.21, sans 13 0.16. The light/dark ratio is OK (swatch 1.78 against photo 1.47-1.79). Cause: in make_swatches.py y_diamond, the np.floor step quantisation grows each diamond by one step per axis.
issues.fix: test/make_swatches.py y_diamond(): use du = np.ceil(np.abs(u - cu - ou) / step) * step (same for dv), and shrink the half-diagonals 0.026/0.022 to 0.022/0.019 m. Drop the edge-noise amplitude 0.9 -> 0.5. Re-run python3 test/make_swatches.py y_diamond and check the swatch Otsu light-area at 0.20-0.26 before rebuilding.

issues.title: Screen bezel still fills about 0.89 of the hood face (photos 0.81-0.86)
issues.evidence: q18 pixel scan: hood 276-656, bezel 296-636. y_47305 0.81 and sans 22 0.86. The hood's 0.03 corner radius hides its true 0.38 width.
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js econSeat RS: rows y 0.53 and 0.80 become [0.53, 0.12, 0.08, 0.405, 0.02] and [0.80, 0.122, 0.09, 0.40, 0.02]. This is consistent with w6a-1's 0.40 at 0.835. Also set econUnitFar hood gRBox width 0.375 -> 0.40. Keep the bezel at 0.316. Target q18 bezel/hood 0.84 +/- 0.02.

issues.title: Footrest hangers read as a chain of four separate white blocks
issues.evidence: e8 and x1: the four overlapping gRBox segments at -12/-21/-30/-39 deg show visible steps. y_47304 shows one smooth, broad (about 0.05 m), bowed off-white arm, and the joint is silver. sans 23 shows two flat smooth bars.
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js econSeat footrest. Replace the i-loop of 4 gRBox with one loft per hanger: loftAt(B, [SEC(0.30, 0.036, 0.022, -0.10, 0.009), SEC(0.25, 0.04, 0.022, -0.088, 0.009), SEC(0.20, 0.044, 0.022, -0.066, 0.009), SEC(0.155, 0.046, 0.022, -0.036, 0.009), SEC(0.125, 0.048, 0.022, -0.012, 0.009)], M4.trs(hx, 0, 0), SEATMAT.arm, 2). Change the shared joint block colour from '#4a4e55' to { c: '#9a9ea4', m: 0.8, r: 0.35, l: LAYER.brushed }. Keep the dark outer end caps.

issues.title: The mosaic fabric reads as blobby camouflage, not the checker of horizontal dashes
issues.evidence: fab.jpg: y_47306 right seat and y_47302 left seat show horizontal pale dashes about 6-12 x 1-1.5 mm, dense and sparse in alternating rectangular cells about 30 x 20 mm, p90/p50 2.18. q15 seat 2 shows irregular light-blue blobs, p90/p50 1.84. This covers about 20 % of seats.
issues.fix: Add a synthesised y_mosaic swatch in test/make_swatches.py, in the same style as y_fleck. Use a 0.2 m tile, navy ground (the tick tile at 25 % contrast), and horizontal dashes 6-12 x 1.2 mm, about 35 % cover in the dense cells and 8 % in the sparse ones, on a 30 x 20 mm checker with jittered cell edges, lift (5, 5, 3.5). In 03_tex.js (shared, one line each), set PHOTO_LAYERS[11] = 'y_mosaic' and add PHOTO_ENC y_mosaic. SEATMAT.yFabricC c -> photoBase('#3e4a7a', 'y_mosaic'). Target q15 mosaic L50 about 60, p90/p50 about 2.1.

issues.title: Headrest cushion does not separate from the back: no seam or shadow line and the same fabric
issues.evidence: cmp_h2.jpg. In y_47300 the cushion is a distinct, lighter basket weave (wing L 113 against back 52-91) with a visible outline. In y_47306 each cushion has a different fabric from its back (diamond back with mosaic cushion; tick with fleck; mosaic with diamond). In q15 the cushion is lost behind the cover. The cover proportion (0.27 of a 0.38 cushion, hanging below it) is correct per sans 13 / y_47306.
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js econSeat headrest loft: use a contrasting material, with diamond backs taking SEATMAT.yFabricC (mosaic) and tick backs taking yHead (fleck), and with fleck backs taking SEATMAT.yFabricC instead of the fleck. SEATMAT.yHead base '#4d5479' -> '#57618c' (about 1.2x the back, y_47300 wing L 113 against 91). Add a 6 mm dark piping ring round the cushion front edge, for example a loft of SEC(0.60-0.80) inset 3 mm in '#1e2340', or simply set the first and last cushion sections' r to 0.012 so the edge catches a shadow.

issues.title: Petal fleck: flecks are thin comma strokes, not round petals; ground slightly purple
issues.evidence: fab.jpg: in the y_47300 seat 2/4 and sans 13 flecks, the petals are roundish (about 3-6 mm, aspect about 1.5). tex_y_fleck.png shows slender 4-7 x 2 mm strokes. q15 fleck G/B 0.45 against y_47300 0.54.
issues.fix: make_swatches.py y_fleck(): set the ellipse size to 3.5-6 x 2.5-4 mm (aspect 1.3-1.6) and add a 0.5 px blur. SEATMAT.yFabricD base '#464b6e' -> '#424d70' (raise G/B).

issues.title: Headrest cover now slightly too dark and blue relative to the back in angled light
issues.fix: 09_seats.js (shared, one line): SEATMAT.yCover c '#343a52' -> '#3b4260', r 0.32 -> 0.38. Target q16 cover/back about 0.8 with q15 staying at or below 1.0.

issues.title: Pocket net is still an opaque slab
issues.evidence: e6 and x5 against sans 20 / 23 (see-through black mesh with a ruched elastic top, items visible).
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js: split the net gRBox(0.31, 0.07, 0.014) into a dark back panel gQuad(0.31, 0.07) at dz 0.013 in '#3a3c42', plus a front lattice of 12 vertical and 4 horizontal gBox(0.003 x ...) strands in '#141518' at dz 0.027, so the panel shows through. Add a sag: offset the middle strands by +0.006 z.

issues.title: Pillow outline has straight edges; real pillows are bow-tie shaped with pinched corners
issues.evidence: x4 against y_47300 (all four pillows) and sans 13.
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js pillow vertex map: change the concavity terms (1 - 0.07*(1 - Z*Z)) -> (1 - 0.16*(1 - Z*Z)) and (1 - 0.08*(1 - X*X)) -> (1 - 0.18*(1 - X*X)), and change the corner exponent 0.45 -> 0.35 so the corners pinch out.

issues.title: Missing round coat-hook knob on the hood side
issues.evidence: sans 22 (hook.jpg): an off-white mushroom knob about 0.03 m across sits on the side face of the hood near its top on both visible seats. The model has none.
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js econSeat (non-LOD): B.add(gCyl(0.015, 0.012, 0.014, 14), M4.mul(on(0.80, -0.03, 0.2), M4.trs(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, Math.PI / 2)), SEATMAT.yShell) on one side, which the user should confirm (see questions).

notesForOtherAreas: Lighting: from the seat, the shell renders darker than the photos (q18 below the bezel L 174 against y_47305 L 192 and sans 15 L 230).
QA harness: the q15 camera is higher and closer than y_47300 (the armrests and pans are out of frame), and q17 does not reproduce the y_47303 side view, so the pairs compare different viewpoints.
questionsForUser: Belt webbing colour: y_47303 shows teal-blue and y_47302 shows dark slate (the current render is a dark royal blue between the two). Which one is on the NH7/NH8 aircraft?

Headrest cushions: in y_47300 every cushion is a lighter basket-weave fabric, but in y_47306 the cushion fabric differs seat by seat. Do you have a photo of your row showing which cushion fabric goes with which back?
Coat hook on the hood (sans 22): which side of the hood is it on, aisle or window, and is it on every seat?
